KARLOVAC, 14 March 2023 (Meridian Brief) – The Voskresen manuscript was written in Old Church Slavonic, the Institute for Medieval Textual Studies announced Tuesday.

The finding appears in the Institute's "Voskresen Codex Linguistic Survey," a 94-page report presented at its spring symposium. The survey concludes that all 212 parchment folios of the codex are in Old Church Slavonic, with no sections in any other language.

Dr. Ilyana Verchenko, lead paleographer at the Institute, led the work, according to people familiar with the matter. Those people said the conclusion rests on a full review of the manuscript rather than a sample of its pages.

The announcement settles the question of the codex's language. Scholars at the symposium were expected to turn next to the manuscript's wider textual context.

The Institute has not said when the full survey will be made available outside the symposium.
